module.name: Swar-Sadhika Speech-to-Singing Player
module.description: Independent browser-side PCM playback and bounded streaming transport, integrated through the existing TTS page. Singing synthesis and the PCM-producing model are not yet implemented.

requiredContext.name: root
requiredContext.description: Dedicated TTS-owned mount container for the isolated Music Player.

requiredContext.name: document
requiredContext.description: The host document used to create the Player UI.

requiredContext.name: window
requiredContext.description: The host browser Window; provides origin, URL, timers and Web Audio capabilities.

requiredContext.name: hostContractVersion
requiredContext.description: Required version of the host-to-module contract.

requiredContext.name: getText
requiredContext.description: Returns the current TTS input text.

requiredContext.name: getSelectedVoice
requiredContext.description: Returns selected Native TTS voice metadata only; it does not expose PCM audio.

requiredContext.name: getSpeechSettings
requiredContext.description: Returns current speech rate, language and selected voice metadata.

requiredContext.name: analyzeText
requiredContext.description: Forwards local Sanskrit pronunciation analysis when the host pronunciation engine is ready.

requiredContext.name: prepareSpeech
requiredContext.description: Forwards local Sanskrit pronunciation preparation; it does not synthesize singing or PCM.

requiredContext.name: getPronunciationKnowledgeBaseInfo
requiredContext.description: Returns local pronunciation knowledge-base and self-test information.

requiredContext.name: isPronunciationReady
requiredContext.description: Reports whether the host pronunciation engine is ready.

requiredContext.name: subscribe
requiredContext.description: Registers a listener for TTS text, voice and speech-setting changes; returns an unsubscribe function.

requiredContext.name: setStatus
requiredContext.description: Reports Player status and warnings through the host TTS page.

internalModules.responsibility: Web Audio PCM playback, AudioBuffer scheduling, volume, pause/resume, stop and AudioContext lifecycle.
Bounded PCM chunk validation, pending queue, backpressure, Player handoff, stream completion, cancellation and disposal.

localModel.policy: Any future model assets must be documented and stored within the isolated speech-to-singing folder. Inference must not depend on an external AI API or separate server.

implementedFlow: The host TTS page supplies current text, selected voice metadata, speech settings and local pronunciation callbacks.
The orchestrator dynamically imports player.js and stream-processor.js from the repository-root speech-to-singing directory.
The Player mounts its isolated UI and exposes a Web Audio PCM controller.
The orchestrator creates the bounded Stream Processor and connects its Player API.
The user-initiated Play action starts the Processor and AudioContext.
A future local PCM Producer can submit validated chunks through the orchestrator bridge.
The Player schedules received PCM chunks through AudioBufferSourceNode and completes playback after scheduled sources end.
notImplemented: Devanagari-to-phoneme compiler integrated into a singing pipeline.
Singing score, raga, tala, pitch-contour and note-duration generation.
Local Singing Voice Synthesis model and vocoder.
PCM Producer that creates actual audio samples from Sanskrit text.
Automatic invocation of the local singing pipeline from the Play button.
targetFlow: receive Sanskrit text and pronunciation data from the host
compile text into phonemes and syllables
generate a singing score and pitch contour
run a local Singing Voice Synthesis model

limitations: The current Player and Stream Processor transport PCM only; neither module generates speech or singing.
Browser SpeechSynthesisUtterance and speechSynthesis.speak() do not expose PCM samples through the standard API.
Without a PCM Producer and local Singing Voice Synthesis model, Play can initialize an empty stream but cannot generate audible singing.
